18: Rava said: the curse stands by itself etc. - there are an oath and a curse here [separately in Rav's formulation], both regarding the woman. However in the verse it is written "with the curse of adjuration" [Numbers 5:21] -- that the oath have the quality of a curse.

I administer an oath to you that if you were defiled, they will come upon you - so, now we have an oath [which includes] a curse [along with it] -- that he administers an oath which states that the curse will take effect.
